title: Pure Mist Tutti Frutti 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Tutti Frutti delivers a vibrant mix of refreshing fruit flavours, creating a layered and satisfying vape. This lively e-liquid is perfect for vapers who enjoy a medley of fruity blends with a fresh and uplifting profile. The Pure Mist High-PG collection offers tailored VG/PG ratios to suit different vaping preferences. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour production, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more pronounced flavour profile with discreet vapour. Designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Tutti Frutti is crafted in the UK with premium ingredients to ensure consistent quality and satisfaction.
